name: soundboard
description: Viewers spend points to play a sound effect on the streamer's machine (!snd airhorn, !snd laugh). Drop audio files (wav/mp3/flac/ogg) into the sounds_dir folder and the module picks them all up automatically — the file stem is the command name. Every clip is normalised (peak-scaled) then played at the single volume, so a quiet and a loud recording sound the same loudness. Sounds play serially: one at a time, the next starts the moment the previous finishes. Optional cooldown_secs adds a fixed pause between plays.
